filename: Thierry Escaich - Le Chant de Tenebres.md
title: Le Chant de Tenebres
identity: The catalogued alto/soprano saxophone piano version is not verified. Thierry Escaich's original Le Chant des ténèbres (1992) is for soprano saxophone and 12 saxophones or strings; Billaudot GB9831 is a later soprano saxophone and organ transcription by Tobias Willi, 15 minutes. A separate Billaudot BILL5367 listing for B-flat saxophone and piano appeared in a retailer catalog and needs identification.

evidence.claim: Escaich's catalogue distinguishes the 1992 original saxophone concerto versions and a separate 2008 clarinet arrangement.
Billaudot identifies GB9831 as soprano saxophone and organ, arranged by Tobias Willi, 15 minutes.
A Billaudot retailer catalog lists BILL5367 as B-flat saxophone and piano.
A performance video listing credits Evgeni Novikov with soprano saxophone and the Amsterdam Conservatory Saxophone Ensemble.

listening.description: Evgeni Novikov and Conservatorium van Amsterdam Saxophone Ensemble performance listing.
listening.verification: Title and credits checked; playback not auditioned.

gaps: Determine which work/edition BILL5367 names and whether it is related to the 1992 concerto or a separate work.
proposed_corrections: Catalog instrumentation should be reviewed against the intended edition. The cited primary catalogues do not establish an alto saxophone and piano edition.
